page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment and is kept as such. "T[?]raso-" has the h under a blot. The paragraph breaks are not clearly marked in the scan, so the page is kept as one continuous paragraph. The "5." and "4." numbers are part of the running text. "incusatum" is as printed.
